nom: TATCHA The Dewy Serum with Hyaluronic Acid & Collagen Amino Acid

avis.texte: Bought this for my mother in law, saw improvement less than a week

I absolutely love the way this product rehydrates my skin midday. It's lightweight and gives thay dewy glow. I would have given this 5 stars, but the smell is kinda awful. It smells nothing like the moisturizer which I love.

I was gifted by tatcha their new dewy milk moisturizer and I absolutely love it. This moisturizer feels amazing on my skin allowing it to look super glowy and hydrated. Overall I would definitely recommend.

I used this product for weeks and it seemed like I had a new breakout every day. Thought maybe I was going through a hormonal flare. As soon as I switched back to Cerave, it started to clear up. This is not good if your skin is super sensitive.

this serum I use in the morning makes my skin feels good and refresh, it has collagen in it so it helps with slow aging and I use another serum for night time it's a great addition to any skin care routine even if you're already using another serum this one has a different purpose. I love it!! BTW I use this alone 2 months before adding my nightly routine I had comments about my face glowing..
I mix this serum in with my Tatcha Dewy Skin Cream in the morning for extra hydration.

I have completely switched my whole skin care to tatcha. I see some of the best results from their brand. Though anyone can use tatcha, it is definitely for mature skin, 25 or older (yes you should start anti aging by 25). Tatcha has a lot of anti aging and healthy aging products, 90% of the product's are firming and line smoothing. This serum could be for anyone though. It makes my skin so soft and plumped. I used this before applying the water cream and it looks flawless. Best skincare for aging skin.

I love all the Dewy products they all help my skin feel smooth and moisterized

I use this with the Dewy moisturizer in the am along with using The Essence first Its a wonderful combination of high quality products that soften lines Im 80 years old and have noticed a great difference

I received this as a free product with my order of cleanser essence and water cream It really quotleveled-upquot my routine my skin looks better than it has for as long as I can remember Very nice product!
I love this serum it is so light and makes my skin feel so smooth Love it!
Every tatcha product I receive outdoes the previous one This one is fantastic! Highly recommend for dry skin
Another amazing product! I put this on before my moisturizer and can tell you it makes my skin glow I even feel that it is plumper and healthier
My skin is so soft I dont need to exfoliate as often as I was before using the system
The Dewy Serum is perfect for hydrating my whole face even the t-zone It feels fresh and soothing

My oilysensitize skin loves this product! My skin is so bouncy and hydrated I love that this brand uses clean ingredients too Obsessed with their products Ive found using this serum with the water cream moisturizer to be the perfect combo - not too heavy but plenty of moisture
I purchased this as a gift for DIL She loved it I too love this product

Great smell and although it left my skin hydrated it left a film covering my skin and a white residue that I had to go and wash off after that defeated the purpose given the price point It was a complete waste of money
This smells soooo nice I love the smooth way this sinks into my skin It pairs really well with my other serum and doesn't feel like I'm caking on more product
This is a great serum seems to give my skin that extra moisture!
Love this product as I do all of your products It glides on effortlessly and feels wonderful on my skin
I am obsessed with this Tatcha line My skin has never felt so soft

I have been using the Dewy Serum for a couple weeks now and I am very impressed with my skin! I am 60yrs old dont wear any makeup just my Tatcha products! My skin feels fantastic in the Arizona dry weather!
A real noticeable smoothness Im 82 and my lines and wrinkles are less obvious and skin feels fabulous
The dewy serum is excellent I have purchased it many times! The problem is that i cannot use it because the pump does not work very disappointing Please let me know what the solution is
I don't have a way to use it no pump straw to draw the serum out
Bottle was empty only product in my purchase that wasnt sealed So I didnt get to try it
Love the product but then again I love all of Tatcha products!
The serum is amazing however the pump was defective I have unscrew the top and tap it onto my hand which makes it hard to control the amount Otherwise definitely love the serum
I love this and keep it on table next to me When I dont feel like going through the whole routine I just put this on Works great
I have sensitive skin but this serum works wonders and is not irritating Its lightweight and smells great I will continue to keep this on hand

avis.titre: OMG get it if you havent
avis.texte: I love how this hydrates my skin Its not too harsh on my face and been keeping my skin glowing as well
I love the dewy serum and have purchased it many times including in travel size This bottle had about 12 pumps of product on in it which is wild for 30
The Dewy Serum is a must in my everyday skincare routine It makes my skin feel so hydrated and plump Im not sure what I would do without it
I have been using this serum for 10 days now only at night and my face is visibly more plump and healthier
Pump didn't work so I can't say whether this product works or not
I love your products but I used it once and it was empty I think it was an empty bottle Disappointed
LOVE the serum but disappointed in the packaging First time buyer and either the pump is broken or maybe there is no pump at all causing me to have to unscrew the cap in order to use the product

I am so impressed with this Serum as with the other products I have tried! I definitely feel that the fine lines are less visible which is just what I was hoping for! I must also compliment Tachas customer service I originally ordered a small bottle of the serum to try it Nothing came out when I pumped it I opened the bottle and it was missing the plastic tube that goes to the bottom of the bottle Also the bottle was only about 14 full I did a chat with a representative and sent a picture of what I found and provided a batch number Within a week I received a full size bottle of serum Now that is customer service!
Ive been using this product for a few weeks now and was having dull dryer skin This has definitely made my skin softer and dewy
I'm liking the product so far however I can't get anything out of the bottle!! I pump the bottle repeatedly but nothing comes out Really bummed

avis.titre: A must have for international travel
avis.texte: I got this as a sample when I purchased the rice wash I didnt think anything of it when I packed it on my trip to Singapore 20 hours flight time I was amazed at how good my skin looked after almost a day of travel I used it everyday and coworkers thought I just got over jet lag that quickly It was light enough it didnt melt off in the high humidity As soon as I landed home Im off to buy the full sized product!
Lightweight and effective a great addition to my skin care routine As a mature woman my skin craves hydration This serum combined with a moisturizer has delivered great results!
Genuinely amazing Makes my skin feel softer and moisturized and firm and oooooh so healthy I love this product
Other skin correctors have been too harsh and irritating my facial skinNow with this and all of the other Tatcha products my skin is definitely less irritated calmer and glowing more

The serum is not what I really expected The dewy moisturizer is a lot better and personally prefer that one The bottle doesn't have much in it plus the pump didn't work so I just have to pour a little bit on my hand which is a waste if I get to put more than I wanted The serum only lasted 1 week for me Prefer a different brand for the serum

For years Ive struggled with combodry and textured skin with hormonal acne thrown in I never thought I would be able to wake up in the morning with a glow but now I do! Every day! I love this stuff it feels amazing on the skin and has made a visible difference in the texture and tone of my skin In December I spent a week in the hospital and had my husband bring my dewy serum from home its essential! Im a Tatcha fan for life! purpleheart

avis.titre: Can't even use it- stings and I break out in a rash
avis.texte: Overhyped I bought two of the touch of gift sets during the holidays because it had such great reviews The face wash and the moisturizer are mediocre at best but I am stuck with two full serums I used it once and broke out in a rash and it stung my skin
A must-have!! I use it underneath my Tatcha moisturizer and my skin doesnt get dry throughout the day like it normally would
I love the hydration and glow this serum gives my skin Its beautiful with out being sticky!

I live in Colorado the high desert plains So Im always on the lookout for anything to add moisture to my face Many products may work for an hour or so But Tatchas serum adds softness and moisture that lasts all day even in our particularly dry winters It manages to do all this without being greasy Love it!

I wasnt sure what to expect as I have tried many serums and havent found one that made me want to buy again So far I am extremely pleased with The Dewy Serumit appears to lock in the moisture after layering with the dewy skin cream My skin has become very dry and I think this is the one-two punch that I needed to alleviate the dryness
I haven't seen much of a difference but I've only used it for a few weeks

I normally use the Dewy Moisturizer so I was excited to try this Unfortunately little dark red spots popped up all over my face and even my hand felt irritated This morning my face is still red from it Ill still keep using the moisturizer I recommend buying the mini size to try it out first heart

avis.titre: Not sure it was a new product
avis.texte: i am not sure this was a new product The tape that is usually on all products was missing and there were no insturctions with the product Other than not being sure how to use this it is a nice product
I have tried numerous serums and this is by far the best for my skin
One of the best moisturizers I have ever tried and I have tried many!!! So fabulous that its hard to keep in my bathroom because my two teenage daughters keep stealing it They love it too!
I have used the dewy serum in the past but when I ran out I forgot to order more and just forgot about it I love this stuff! It makes a big difference! My skin has never looked better!
I love the serum it does work nice my face feels fresh and like firm or tight The only down side is the bottle size is really big for the 1oz they have in there
This helps with my dry skin I also use the Dewy Moisturizer I love Tatcha's skincare
I found this product as well as the dewy moisturizer love both products and continue to use this and nothing else!

Love the Dewy Serum and how healthy it makes my skin look My MIL mentioned several times that my skin looks fresh rested and has a nice gentle glow Tatcha's customer service is also unlike any I've experienced - they are amazing fast and responsive I do not typically leave reviews for products this may actually be my first review - however I can't express enough how wonderful this serum and other related Tatcha products is!
Love this serum Absorbs quickly Keeps my skin looking fabulous for 53 turns around the sun
Leaves my skin feeling soft and smooth without the tackiness of most serums
I havent used consistently Im changing my routine so that I do use consistently But so far I havent been impressed

I think I will use this serum from now until spring My skin leans toward oily most of the year but gets somewhat dry in cooler weather This will be perfect for that Love the feel of it as it goes in and doesn't feel as if I am adding another layer of anything to my skin Have fallen in love with everything Tatcha!
Two pumps after washing my face A little goes a long way My face feels so good

I absolutely looove this serum Ive been getting so many compliments on my skin since Ive switched to Tatcha I use this morning and night paired with the Dewy Moisturizer Its UNBELIEVABLE how my dark spots are fading on my cheeks No other brand has been able to give me these results! Ive found my new skincare home
Love this product! It makes my skin so silky and pairs amazingly with a lot of my skincare creams

Keeps your skin feeling moisturized and I have noticed that my on-set wrinkles have started to lighten with the Tatcha routine Product really smells nice - it's light and refreshing nothing too overwhelming Texture wise - it'll just sit on your face like a second skin - no excess oiliness I started with mini sizes because my skin is super sensitive and it's hard for me to find a skincare brand that works on my skin But all of Tatcha products so far has been a blessing
Its a perfect dewy serum you can see fast result Amazing product

avis.titre: My face is scarred for life
avis.texte: I have had the same skin care regimen for 25 years I saw tatcha on QVC and was intrigued I have dry facial skin I used it one time and woke up to a boil on my chin My pore was so swollen and infected that there was an actual hole in my face It was so swollen and painful that I had to go to the ER and they administered antibiotics intravenously This stuff is poison I wish I could post a picture of the damage this stuff did to my face
Love all the products i have tried Have given Tatcha gifts to my daughters and sisters
I love this stuff It makes my face glow and it feels great Has a great smell and I plan to use it forever

I used to use the Luminous Deep Hydration Firming Serum That one was fabulous This one is okay They market this as better because you can use it day and night What it translates to is that this one is less thick and less effective It doesnt firm as well It doesnt moisturize as well The container is also significantly smaller - this one is 1 oz the other was the standard 17 Its quite disappointing to see Tatcha pushing a less effective product in a smaller bottle after discontinuing such an amazing one Tatcha has made a few changes lately that dont seem too customer focused Its also ridiculous that you cant see how much product is in the bottle

avis.titre: Perfect balance of creamy and decadent aroma
avis.texte: The serum is creamy and leaves a light aroma The glow it promotes is fresh My fav!
This is perfect for daytime here in Florida Its too hot in the day for a thick cream so this is great This has such a light texture but it feels so luxurious on my skin I love you Tatcha!

I absolutely love this serum It makes my skin feel so hydrated but most of all it works magic on my sunspots It sounds crazy but within two days I could see a noticeable lightening of my sunage spots! Im hooked!
Does not disappoint- best way to hydrate my skin and works amazing with the moisturizer Get compliments on my skin all the time now
